title: catalyst report
description: What `catalyst report --json` prints: the journal's and the deployment's figures, over the whole journal or `--since` a date (catalyst >= 0.95.0 describes it).

tiers.description: Entries per tier; `untiered` for those without one.

commands.description: The ten commands most entries name, most first.

active_days.description: Days with at least one entry.

artifacts.description: For each entity type, its artifacts per status.

commits.description: Non-merge commits in the window (the last 200 without `--since`).

commits_traced.description: Those whose message names an artifact or rule, or carries a chore prefix.

unrecorded_commits.description: Commits with changes outside catalyst since the baseline.

adopted_commits.description: Entries that adopted such a change.
